messages:
adri: quick heads-up — saw ~2% of leads land owner=null during last peak. Looks like enrichment callback races with RR.

mike: timeline? HS or SF?

adri: both. intake -> /lead-enrich returns 202 -> callback delayed -> assign job runs and writes owner=null.

tara: short-term: add a 30s handshake window. mark leads pending instead of null owner while waiting. fallback to `sdr-overflow` after window.

mike: config idea:
```
routing.handshake_seconds=30
routing.pending_flag=true
routing.fallback_pool="sdr-overflow"
routing.retry_jitter_ms=2000
```

adri: also add lead property `routing_note=handshake_runbook` and `enrich_payload_id` for tracing.

tara: Observability: emit `routing.handshake_wait_ms`, `routing.fallback.count`, `routing.unassigned.rate`. Alert if unassigned_rate > 1% over 15m.

adri: SalesOps wants CSV export for any leads routed to fallback so SDRs can avoid duplicate outreach.

salesops-bot: SalesOps notified: will prep CSV template and standby for canary start time.

mike: QA tests: delayed callback 70s -> fallback + routing_note; fast callback <10s -> normal assign; duplicate callbacks -> idempotent.

tara: rollout plan: feature flag 5% canary for 1h, monitor metrics, expand to 25% if stable. rollback = flip flag off + revert fallback.

ops-bot: Created TASK-4702: "handshake window canary + fallback export" assigned to growth-eng. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/TASK-4702

adri: will open HS workflow PR to gate POST /assign on `enrichment_status=complete` or handshake expiry. ping here when PR is up. :thumbsup:
